dedupe_keys.name: ztbus a large dataset of time resolved city bus driving missions

description: ZTBus: A Large Dataset of Time-Resolved City Bus Driving Missions is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Fabio Widmer et al. This paper presents the Zurich Transit Bus (ZTBus) dataset, which consists of data recorded during driving missions of electric city buses in Zurich, Switzerland. The data was collected over several years on two trolley buses as part of multiple research projects. It involves more than a thousand missions across all seasons, each mission usually covering a full day of operation. Coverage: national (CH); published in 2023. Formats: ZIP, CSV, TXT. The data are held in ETH Zurich and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
